risks.title: Railroad Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is heavily dependent on railroads for its intermodal operations, making it vulnerable to changes in railroad pricing, service, or strategy. (Item 1A, p. 7)

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive market with numerous competitors that could reduce prices to gain market share. (Item 1A, p. 8)

risks.title: Shortage of Qualified Drivers
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on qualified drivers for its operations, but persistent shortages could impact its ability to provide services. (Item 1A, p. 7)

risks.title: Economic and Macroeconomic Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to economic risks such as recessions, interest rate changes, commodity price fluctuations, and inflation. (Item 1A, p. 9)

risks.title: Fuel Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to fuel-related risks, such as price fluctuations and supply disruptions, which directly affect operating costs. (Item 1A, p. 10)

risks.title: Extreme Weather Events
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to risks related to extreme weather conditions, such as hurricanes and flooding, which could impact its operations. (Item 1A, p. 10)

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to regulatory risks, such as changes in environmental standards or road safety regulations. (Item 1A, p. 9)
